comments.author: @UnseenOutlands
comments.text: The flooded forests of the Amazon might be the most fascinating part of this documentary. How do riverside families adapt their homes, transportation, fishing, and farming when water levels change so dramatically? Are there traditional ways of predicting seasonal floods that communities still rely on, and how are changing rainfall patterns affecting those rhythms today?

replies.author: @UnseenOutlands
replies.text: @ImpossibleTravel38 Oh, I wonder if they have to maintain those empty wooden pillars underwater regularly?

replies.author: @ImpossibleTravel38
replies.text: Riverside families adapt by building homes on stilts or floating logs, using canoes for transport, and timing their agriculture to the changing water levels. ❤️
